q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

checks.what: tool: measures the change with compare_period

answer:
Sales did not drop yesterday — net sales rose to ₹91,220 on 2026-10-13 from ₹40,119 on 2026-10-12 (+127.4%), so yesterday was materially stronger than the day before.

What changed (ordered by impact)
- More orders: Orders 26 → 45 (+73.1%). This was the biggest volume swing and explains most of the sales increase.
- Higher AOV: AOV ₹2,116 → ₹2,694 (+27.3%), so each order was worth more yesterday as well.
- More ad investment: Ad spend ₹38,661 → ₹50,442 (+30.5%). Ad spend moved with sessions and conversions but the data does not establish direction (could be cause or response).
- Returns / refunds and discounts changed but did not overturn the increase: discount and deduction lines rose, but gross sales and product sales increases dominated.

What we can (and cannot) say
- The data shows what moved (orders, AOV, ad spend) but the diagnosis found no single supported causal driver — sessions, add-to-carts and ad spend all moved together and the system cannot tell whether ad spend caused the lift or reacted to it.
- Scope used: order-date figures for the default brand (Tilting Heads). Today’s data snapshot is complete through 2026-10-13.

Worth checking: a campaign or channel-level breakdown for 2026-10-13 to see which ads/campaigns produced the extra orders and AOV.
